module: Flowgraph node "Rally Stage Runtime State" (category repeat_instant, tag rally). Reads the stage runtime state held by the RallyManager: puts the manager in 'tracker' authority mode, activates the stage (setStageRuntimeActive(true)) and sends onRallyDataUpdated with the stageActive state while flow is active. Outputs: flow, active (stage active), complete (tracking finished, via getStageObserverState().stageComplete) and time (stage time in s: currentSSTime or getStageRuntimeTime, last value kept).

work.desc: Every frame: resets the outputs to zero then fills them from the rally manager.
